scope: Sweep allocations reached inside the AC1024 OBJECTS callback while emitting typed base, dimension-body pair, real/integer value, and geometry associative dependency records.

source.profile: The base dependency profile has class version 3, status -7, read/attached flags, dependency order -2, present name allocation-retry, body id -9, and a non-null body handle to the paired dimension body. The paired ASSOCDIMDEPENDENCYBODY has handle 0xE902, parent 0xE901, name BOLTHOLE, version-1 body/base/class fields, and one complete 30-bit dependency-body prefix with four decoded values. The real value-dependency profile adds class version 0, name VALUE_DEPENDENCY, and real value 12.5. The integer value-dependency profile adds class version 0, name VALUE_DEPENDENCY, and signed int32 value 17. The geometry profile adds class version 0, enabled state, AcDbAssocSingleEdgePersSubentId, and dependent-on-compound-object state; dependency references and subentity indices remain null/default.

implementation.method: Warm and calibrate each record profile in ASCII and Binary. For the base profile, emit the dependency and linked dimension body in one OBJECTS callback. Inject std::bad_alloc at every reached callback offset; require failed whole-file publication, byte-identical destination sentinel preservation, caller-record preservation, same-codec retry, and fresh DXF typed readback of the dependency/body links and fields plus both value variants and geometry fields.

validation.ascii: Base dependency + dimension body pair: 12/12; real value dependency: 8/8; integer value dependency: 8/8; geometry dependency: 8/8 callback allocation offsets injected. Destination and source records were preserved; same-codec retry and typed readback passed.
validation.binary: Base dependency + dimension body pair: 12/12; real value dependency: 7/7; integer value dependency: 7/7; geometry dependency: 7/7 callback allocation offsets injected. Destination and source records were preserved; same-codec retry and typed readback passed.

limitations: Generated serialization and transaction evidence only; no physical producer prevalence or native associative semantics are established.

The DWG prefix bit span and decoded-count metadata used to admit the generated body are not DXF fields; typed DXF readback asserts only serialized body versions/name/owner and the dependency handle link.

The paired dependency/body route closes only its generated body-handle and owner link. It has no actual dimension entity, constraint group, node, value-dependency edge, source-backed profile, or native constraint semantics. The generated value profiles cover one real value and one signed int32 value. Geometry coverage is limited to a generated default-index SingleEdge profile.
nextAction: Continue rooted dimension-constraint transaction work from the hash-bound AC1024 physical source profile. First measure the OBJECTS callback allocation count for the existing physical output/readback route; keep the generated-only strict-output refusal and source-lineage gates intact, and split the work into a bounded fast selector if the whole physical callback sweep is too expensive.
